description: List the event types you can subscribe a webhook endpoint to. Returns event-type strings like `domain.registered`, `domain.renewed`, `domain.transfer.completed`, `domain.expiring`, `dns.record.created|updated|deleted`, `cloudflare.connect.completed|failed` and `account.verification.code_sent|completed`. What each event sends: https://porkbun.com/llms/webhooks. Use these values (or `*` for all, or a prefix wildcard like `dns.*`) when calling create_webhook.
name: get_webhook_event_types
